title: Dolt health intelligence and self-healing
objective: Give Beadle users visibility into per-project Dolt server health because agents operate bd most of the time: detect port collisions, unpinned default ports, and cross-repository database contamination; self-heal 'database not found on Dolt server' failures by pinning a free port and starting the server; stagger parallel refresh cold starts; add a Swift test target for the health engine.
acceptance_criteria: Health findings separate critical contamination (foreign database inside a project's data directory, own database served from another repository, effective port shared with another project) from warnings (unpinned default port).
A refresh failure matching bd's port-collision error triggers one automated repair: pin a free unused port, start the Dolt server, retry the load, and report what was done.
Project refreshes are staggered so simultaneous cold starts do not race to bind the default Dolt port.
A Dolt health view lists per-project port, database, and findings with fix actions.
The health engine is covered by a Swift test target, and swift build plus git diff --check pass.
